Ref: EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

- ·Concrete truck delivery access and delivery sequence
- ·Barricading andNo GoZonesfor concrctcdclivcry opcration
- Overheadpowerlinesand other obstructions.
- Before the commencement of the concrete pumping operations, the relevant concrete and concrete pumping contractor/sub-contractor,should provide the Contractor with the following H&S documentation:
- oSafe Systems of Work (SsOW) and method statements for the general operation of the concrete pump and thc ovcrall activity of the concrete pour
- Sitespecificmethod statementsfor the actualworktobeperformed onsite:
- The set-up of the concrete pumping unit
- .The concrete pumping operation
- Clean up procedures
- Preparationforroad travel oncompletion ofwork
- Plant safetyhazard identification/riskassessmentsfortheconcretepumping unit
- Current equipment maintenance log books
- Manufacturer’smanual and operator'sinstructions
- An annual inspection report signed by a qualified engineer verifying that the concretepumping unit isin soundmechanical condition and the placingboom doesnot exhibit critical areas ofwear and stress
- ·Certificates of competency or equivalentfor operation of truckmounted concrete placing boom
- ·If required a SsOw for the operation near overhead power lines of a concrete placing boom
- If required the nomination and qualifications of the designatcd spottcr for power line NO GO ZONES.
- The concrete pump operator and the Contractor must ensure that no persons are directly under the slewing radius of the concrete placing boom operation. A spotter and/or barricades will be provided for that purpose.
- Barricades and suitable signage should be installed around the perimeter of the work zone to exclude persons (other than the concrete sub-contractor's employees and the concrete pump operator) from the area in which the concrete pour activity is taking place.
- > The concrete pumping contractor should ensure the following controls are in place before commencing pumping operations:
- 。The earth safety chain has been deployed
- ·The concrete pump unit's outriggers have been securely and properly positioned
